notes: APK bytes describe the whole supplied app, not an incremental cost by themselves.
APK size is not installed size or Play download size.
A delta is meaningful only with identical app sources, assets, shrinker settings, toolchain, and build variant except library integration.
The two minimal-app release flavors share Activity source, assets, application ID, SDK settings, and build options; only withCompressor declares the library dependency.
The delta includes transitive dependencies without shrinking. Existing apps may already share them; this is not the cost after R8 optimization.
